name: Tutorial: SELECT
description: Inspect the modules and identify faulty readings.

tutorial.message: Welcome! This is your first mission. You will learn to identify faulty systems using queries.
Start by inspecting the available systems in the console on the below.
Hint: Use queries like 'SELECT * FROM Airlock;' to view sensor data.
Check all systems visually for unusual readings: fuel, temperature, pressure, voltage.
Identify the row with the abnormal readings by using select statements and click 'Identify Faults' to mark it.
To get the highest efficiency make sure to focus in on the fault before clicking 'Identify Faults', e.g., SELECT * FROM Engine WHERE fuel_level < 10
Once you've identified all issues, the mission will complete.
Mission complete! You successfully identified the faulty systems.
